pr_title: tests: kernel: timer: timer_behavior: Tweak expected std deviation
pr_body:
If frequency of the system clock is lower then deviation may exceed default value (10us). Instead of adjusting the default value, test is rounding up expected standard deviation to a single clock cycle.

Fixes #71863.
pr_comments: I like the change, agree with @golowanow the calculation should be done once before the TC_PRINT and zaasert usage

4. See console output with error
